entities.description: The grass is dry, yellowish-brown, and sparse, covering the ground in a savanna-like environment. It appears brittle and scattered, with some patches of bare earth visible between the blades.

A young boy with short dark hair sits on a colorful striped mat with his back to the camera, wearing a white t-shirt and blue jeans. He is positioned in the foreground, facing towards other people and a basket of oranges.

A young Black boy with short dark hair sits in profile facing left, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt with a black graphic print and blue denim shorts. He is seated on a colorful patterned mat with his legs crossed, looking off into the distance with a neutral expression.

A smiling woman with light skin and dark hair stands outdoors wearing a long, loose-fitting purple abaya with intricate white embroidery on the V-neckline, cuffs, and hem, paired with a matching purple hijab. She has her hands clasped in front of her waist, and a pile of oranges is visible at the bottom of the frame.

clothing.details: white embroidery on neckline, cuffs, and hem

entities.description: A young girl with dark skin sits in profile facing right, wearing a bright red headscarf and a long-sleeved blue tunic, positioned next to a young boy in a pink shirt on a patterned mat in a dry, grassy field.

A young Black boy with short black hair is shown in profile facing right, wearing a salmon-pink short-sleeved t-shirt. He is seated outdoors with a blurred background of dry, golden-brown grass, looking forward with a neutral expression.

A young Black boy with short dark hair sits in profile facing right, wearing a teal t-shirt, looking upward with a focused expression. In the foreground, the back of another child's head and white shirt is visible, partially obscuring the view.

A young child with short dark hair sits on a colorful patterned mat with their back to the camera, wearing a red long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans. To the left is a basket of oranges, and to the right is another person partially visible.

A young Black boy with short, dark, curly hair is shown in profile, looking upward and to the left with a serious expression. He is wearing a grey sleeveless shirt with a white V-neck trim over a white short-sleeved t-shirt, sitting outdoors in a field of dry, yellowish grass.

entities.description: The sky is a pale, washed-out white or very light gray, appearing overcast or hazy with no visible clouds or distinct features. It serves as a bright, uniform background behind the silhouettes of tree branches and leaves.

A blurry, out-of-focus tree with a flat, umbrella-like canopy and a slender trunk stands in the background against a hazy, light-colored sky. The tree appears to be an acacia, typical of a savanna landscape, with a muted greenish-brown color.

A single, tall acacia tree with a flat, umbrella-shaped canopy stands in the center of a dry, grassy landscape. The tree has a slender, dark trunk that branches out near the top to support the wide, spreading crown of leaves, which appears brownish-green. The background is blurred, showing a hazy sky and indistinct vegetation, suggesting a savanna environment.
A blurry, out-of-focus tree with a dark trunk and branches extending into a canopy of muted green and brown foliage, set against a hazy, light-colored background.

A large, solitary tree with a wide, flat, umbrella-shaped canopy of green leaves stands in the center of a dry, grassy landscape. The tree has a single, dark, relatively thin trunk that branches out near the top to support the broad crown, and the background is heavily blurred, showing a hazy horizon and a smaller, indistinct tree to the right.

trunk.structure: single main stem with high branching

A blurry, dark green tree with a broad, umbrella-like canopy stands against a pale, out-of-focus background. The trunk is thick and dark, partially obscured by the blur, and the foliage appears dense and rounded at the top.
A large, mature tree with a thick, textured brown trunk that splits into two main branches, supporting a canopy of sparse, small green leaves that partially frames the top of the scene.
